scores.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark theme with a single muted blue accent, intentional CSS variable system, and well-structured multi-panel linked layout elevate this above generic; the bottom thumbnail grid is too dense to read individual blocks, and the panel labels disappear into the busy content at rendered size.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Bar baseline is zero, all size encodings correctly use scaleSqrt, scale domains are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max — only minor issue is network node radii rescale their domain on filter subsets, making relative node sizes incomparable across filter states.
scores.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag RAF coalescing correctly prevents redundant DOM mutations across all brush events, but O(N) bitFilter computation still runs synchronously on every mousemove tick, risking jank on the 34K-block dataset; no infinite loops, mid-flight snaps, or touch fight issues found.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter views (timeline, network, color scatter, thumbnail gallery) stay within working memory limits, but the network panel is a dense hairball with crossing edges that obscures individual API co-occurrence relationships despite visible hub nodes, and the thumbnail wall shifts the bottom panel toward lookup rather than comparison.
